drafts.subject: Invoice NSF003938 (PO 4500012114) - quantity billed exceeds quantity received
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice NSF003938 dated 6 September 2026 against our purchase order 4500012114 (docket DD580548), totalling $5,082.00 including GST.

On checking the invoice against our goods receipts, we found a difference on line 1 (Machine stretch film 23um x 500mm). The invoice bills 120 rolls, but we have received 96 rolls, so we are 24 rolls short. The value of the shortfall is $924.00 excluding GST.

Could you please:
1. Issue a credit note for the 24 roll shortfall ($924.00 excluding GST, plus GST as applicable), referencing invoice NSF003938; and
2. Let us know whether the remaining 24 rolls are still to be delivered, or whether they were not shipped.

Once the credit note is received, we will arrange payment for the 96 rolls received. If you believe the full 120 rolls were delivered, please send us the signed delivery docket and we will review it promptly.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
